name: Green Beans and Artichokes
description: A savory side dish featuring green beans and artichoke hearts mixed with garlic, onion, and Romano cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 (14 oz) can artichokes, drained and quartered
½ cup freshly grated Romano cheese
1 (10 oz) pkg frozen french-style green beans, cooked and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Saute the onion and garlic in olive oil until the onion is softened.
Stir in bread crumbs and cook until they absorb the oil.
Add green beans, artichoke hearts, and cheese. Combine thoroughly.
Heat slowly to soften the cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

keywords: green beans, artichokes, Romano cheese, side dish

_similar.name: Artichoke Appetizer
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

_similar.keywords: artichoke appetizer, cheesy dip, party snack

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Pasta & Bean Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful soup featuring pasta, beans, and vegetables in a tomato-based broth.
recipeIngredient: 19 oz can white kidney or romano beans, drained
10 oz can chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water
3 cups small shell pasta or macaroni

recipeInstructions.text: Place oil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, uncovered, stirring often, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and juice, seasoning, and beans. Break up tomatoes. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, increase heat, and bring to a boil. Add pasta or macaroni. Boil gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 8 minutes.
If desired, add additional hot broth or water for more broth. Stir in basil and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: pasta soup, bean soup, Italian soup, vegetable broth

_similar.name: Sliced Bean Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

_similar.keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans

_similar.name: Spareribs to Go
_similar.description: A versatile spareribs recipe that can be broiled or heated in a glaze sauce, perfect for make-ahead meals.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil spareribs, cut into serving pieces, in salted water for 1½ hours. Drain and place in a shallow dish.
Pour the glaze mixture (garlic and honey) over the ribs. May be frozen for later use.
To finish, remove ribs from the glaze and broil 6 inches from heat in the oven or barbecue until crisp. Alternatively, baste ribs and heat in the sauce.

_similar.keywords: spareribs, garlic honey glaze, make-ahead ribs
